title: Divisions
description: Work goes to a division. Its head does the task or hands parts to members; the code lead builds in one sandbox with the subagents. Every employee belongs to one division.
viewerNote: Only an Owner or Admin can change divisions.
confirmDelete: Delete the division {name}? Its people stay employees, without a division. Their tasks and history are kept.
headcount: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody yet} one {# person} other {# people}}
parallel: {count, plural, one {# task at a time} other {# tasks at a time}}
noHead: No head yet: tasks for this division need one.
sandbox: works inside the code lead's sandbox

unassigned.title: Not in a division
unassigned.help: Drag someone onto a division, or use the add list on its card.

empty.title: No divisions yet
empty.description: Create a division, then add its head and members.

actions.toSubagent: Work as subagent of the code lead

form.description: Members, the head and the code lead are set on the division's card.
form.name: Name
form.keyHelp: Short, stable name employees use for handoffs, such as delivery. Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.
form.maxParallelHelp: How many of this division's tasks may run at once.
form.dailyBudgetHelp: For all members together. Empty: only each employee's own budget applies.
form.orderHelp: Lower numbers come first on the org chart.
form.sopHelp: How this division works. Each employee reads the version in their output language.

brief.title: Brief {team}
brief.briefPlaceholder: The head decides how it gets done: alone, or by handing parts to members and reviewing their work.

responder.title: Who answers in the division chat
responder.help: When a message mentions nobody. An @mention always reaches that member.

lead.label: Head
lead.description: The head answers and can delegate to members.

mentions.label: Mentions only
mentions.description: Only @mentioned members answer; otherwise nobody does.

auto.label: Automatic
auto.description: A fast model picks the best-suited member; unsure picks go to the head.
